meta.title: lune trace
meta.description: lune tier-1a trace IR wire format (Phase 5b). The on-disk form of a committed, cached Trace (src/trace.zig). Canonical source; the Zig encoder/decoder under src/gen/ is generated from this by tools/regen-trace-schema.sh and vendored. Consumer: the time-travel visualiser (Phase 7).

ConstString.description: A heap string constant: the raw bytes (lune strings are byte strings, not necessarily UTF-8).

ConstValue.description: A trace constant. `tag` mirrors lune's Value.Tag enum (nil=0, boolean=1, int=2, float=3, heap_ref=4). A heap_ref const is always a string (tables/closures are never compile-time constants).

IrInstr.description: One SSA instruction: op, two operand refs, aux immediate, observed type, snapshot index.

SlotStore.description: A loop-carried writeback: tier-0 register `slot` <- IR value `ref` at the back-edge.

Trace.description: A committed, cached trace. The anchor is a stable proto id (assigned at compile time) plus the loop-header pc; the in-memory *const Proto pointer is never serialized.

TraceFile.description: The top-level artifact: a version word followed by the whole trace cache. The richer recording header (hash seed, FP mode, env snapshot) belongs with effect-recording and is deferred to a later phase.
